channel.title: Jaz & Theo
channel.description: Weddings, portraits, the desert Southwest and making a home.

item.title: How Much Does Wedding Photography Cost in 2026?
item.description: Wedding photography prices vary widely. Here is what couples commonly see in 2026, what changes the number, and an estimator to plan your own budget.

item.title: How to Build a Wedding Photography Timeline That Actually Works
item.description: Most rushed wedding days are a scheduling problem, not a photography problem. Here is how to plan every block of the day, with buffers that keep it calm.

item.title: Golden Hour Photography: When It Happens and How to Use It
item.description: Golden hour is not always an hour, and it is not always golden. Here is how to predict the light for your session and what to do when it does not cooperate.

item.title: El Paso Engagement Photo Locations: Mountains, Dunes and Downtown
item.description: El Paso gives you mountains, sand dunes, desert gardens and a historic downtown within a short drive. Here is how to choose, and when to go.

item.title: The Arizona Desert Elopement Guide: Locations, Permits and Timing
item.description: Saguaros, red rock and wide-open sky. Here is how to plan an Arizona desert elopement that is legal, permitted, safe in the heat and timed to the light.

item.title: What to Wear for Engagement Photos: Colors, Fabrics and Fit
item.description: Coordinate, do not match. A practical guide to engagement photo outfit colors, fabrics and fit, with ideas for the desert, the city and cooler seasons.

item.title: Austin Wedding Photo Locations: Hill Country, Lakes and Downtown
item.description: Limestone bluffs, river views, painted murals and live oaks. A practical guide to Austin portrait spots for wedding days and engagement sessions.

item.title: The Senior Portrait Session Checklist: From Booking to Photo Day
item.description: Senior photos go faster and look better with a little planning. Here is a step-by-step checklist for seniors and parents, from booking to the drive home.

item.title: Planning a Lake Powell Wedding or Elopement
item.description: Red rock, blue water and almost no one else around. Here is how to plan a Lake Powell wedding or elopement, from permits to boats to sunset timing.

item.title: How to Build a Peg Rail Shelf on a Shiplap Entry Wall
item.description: A peg rail shelf is one of the most useful things you can add to an entryway. Here is how to size it, make or buy the pegs, and mount it on shiplap.

item.title: Senior Pictures in Tucson: Downtown and Desert in One Session
item.description: Tucson gives you painted walls and historic adobe in the morning and saguaros at sunset. Here is how to combine downtown and desert in one senior session.

item.title: Downtown Los Angeles Senior Photos: A DTLA Session Guide
item.description: Historic theaters, murals, glass towers and old-school neon: DTLA packs a lot of variety into a few blocks. Here is how to plan a senior session there.

item.title: Downtown El Paso Christmas Lights: A Winter Photo Session Guide
item.description: Winter in El Paso is short, bright and surprisingly cold after dark. Here is how to plan engagement or senior photos around the downtown holiday lights.

item.title: Red Sands El Paso: A Photo Session Guide to the Dunes
item.description: The dunes on El Paso's east side are one of the most dramatic backdrops in the region. How to plan an engagement or portrait session there, and what to bring.

item.title: All About Windows: Efficiency, Natural Light and Treatments
item.description: How to read a window label, which frames and glass suit your climate, where to place windows for good light, and treatments that keep heat where you want it.

item.title: Home Organization Labels: How to Make Them Helpful, Not Hurtful
item.description: A good label tells everyone in the house where things go. A practical guide to labeling pantries, closets and kids' rooms, plus a gentle note on labeling people.

item.title: How to Hang Light Fixtures: Sizes, Heights and Spacing That Work
item.description: The rules of thumb for sizing a chandelier, hanging it at the right height over your table, spacing pendants and adding light to an empty corner.

item.title: How to Find Your Wedding Photographer (and What to Ask)
item.description: Your photos are the one part of the wedding you keep forever. Here is a step-by-step way to find the right photographer and the questions worth asking.

item.title: A South Dakota to Yellowstone Road Trip: Route, Stops and Photo Tips
item.description: From the Badlands to the Black Hills to Yellowstone's East Entrance: a practical route, the stops worth slowing down for, and how to photograph them.

item.title: Gila Valley Temple Wedding Photos: A Planning and Photo Guide
item.description: How a Gila Valley Temple wedding day usually flows, when to plan photos on the grounds, and the small-town spots nearby that round out the gallery.
